policy: A conflict blocks a current-tense product claim in support, product AI, documentation, marketing, and release notes until a designated owner resolves it with source evidence.

prohibitedClaims: Arq currently has a released 3D view.
Arq has no 3D surface at all.
conflicts.resolutionRequired: Reconcile the implementation, consumer wiring, test coverage, and status record in one reviewed change. Add browser-level proof before publishing a current capability claim.

evidence: scripts/run-model-canvas-capability-check.mjs (3 consecutive passing runs: 3D tab reachable, WebGL2 surface renders, selection shared plan<->3D both directions, zero console errors)
